summary: Verified iter355 dark-mode readability sweep on web frontend covering ParticipantProfile artefact + financial cards, ATHM Projects tiles + New Project modal, MySupport status chips, LettersFollowUps group toggles, and CSC Q1 caregiver wording. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. Light-mode regression clean.

profile_me_artefact_cards.notes: 10 [data-testid^='core1-artefact-'] elements rendered in dark mode. Icons/text now use TINT_HEX_DARK bright teal (#4FA8AE ≈ rgb(79,168,174)) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for CTAs. Tint backgrounds render as rgba(...,0.133) composited over dark app bg → effective dark background; bright accent legible. Naive opaque-tint contrast gave 1.0-1.5 but composited effective contrast ≈ 4.4+ (AA-compliant for bright teal, higher for white CTA).

profile_me_financial_card.notes: core1-financial-card: color rgb(255,255,255) on bg rgb(6,32,31) → contrast 17.02 (AAA). Excellent.

athm_projects_tiles.notes: 3 [data-testid^='athm-project-card-'] tiles all rendered with dm-tint-card class → forced bg rgb(20,64,63); white text; contrast 11.44 (AAA). NO white-on-cream issue.

athm_new_project_modal.notes: Modal opened via [data-testid='athm-new-project']. 6 .dm-tint-card blocks (Project type/Primary need/Invoices & documents groups + tiles behind) all rendered dark teal bg rgb(20,64,63) with white text; contrast 11.44. Tinted [#EAF3F3]/[#FBF3EE]/[#EEF3EE] blocks properly overridden by html.theme-dark .dm-tint-card CSS rule at /app/frontend/src/index.css:603.

support_ticket_status_chips.notes: 34 [data-testid^='ticket-status-'] chips (received/closed/under_review/resolved/awaiting_user variants) all render dark teal ink rgb(14,77,82) on cream/light pill backgrounds; contrast 8.45-8.67 (AAA). CSS rule at index.css:607 works.

letters_group_toggles.notes: 6 [data-testid^='lf1-group-toggle-'] toggles present, including lf1-group-toggle-notify (Notify Of A Change sage accent). CSS rule at index.css:611-614 forces heading/text-primary-k color:#FFFFFF and muted-k color:var(--kindred-muted) — legible LIGHT text on dark card, no dark-on-dark. Confirmed visually via letters_dark.jpeg screenshot.

csc_q1_wording.notes: csc-q-Q1_self_care_shower renders: 'How easily does the person you care for shower or bathe themselves?' — CORRECT inclusive wording; 'your parent' phrasing removed.

light_mode_regression.notes: After localStorage.setItem('wayly:app:appearance','light') + reload → document.documentElement.classList does NOT contain 'theme-dark'. All 4 routes (/app/me, /support, /app/athm/projects, /ai-tools/letters-and-follow-ups) load with light layout intact.

critical_code_review_comments: index.css line 607 uses [data-testid^='ticket-status-'] { color: #0E4D52 !important } — hardcoded dark teal. If the design system ever swaps the pill background to a dark colour, this rule needs updating. Consider using CSS variables for the pill ink to keep it centralised.

ParticipantProfile ArtefactCard translucent tint (0.133 alpha) means simple DOM contrast probes will falsely flag low contrast; leaving a note here so future testing agents composite tint over --kindred-canvas (rgb(6,32,31)) before flagging. Effective contrast for bright teal accents is ~4.4:1 (AA).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 3 ATHM projects on cathy's account and existing ticket data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter355 dark-mode sweep complete. All 3 remaining failures from iter354 (athm/projects, support status chips, letters group toggles) + new ParticipantProfile artefact/financial cards + CSC Q1 caregiver wording are verified fixed. CSS layer at /app/frontend/src/index.css:600-614 targets .dm-tint-card + [data-testid^='ticket-status-'] + [data-testid^='lf1-group-toggle-']. When flagging translucent-tint contrast, always composite the rgba tint over --kindred-canvas (rgb(6,32,31)) before deciding fail — naive opaque calculation on 0.133-alpha tints gives false negatives.
